purpose: Independent practice of C4 step 1 (situation and question).
student_learning_goal: I can describe a town situation and ask a math question about it.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can describe a town situation and ask a math question about it.
header.character_watermark: Mayor Mira in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Pick a town location. Draw or write 2-3 sentences describing it.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. A description box.

image_placeholders.description: A description box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'Town location: ___' on top. 3 description lines below. Small drawing area on the right. Header 'My Town Description:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_DESC: keywords (town, description) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Should describe a real town location.

parts.student_instructions: Write 4 math questions about your town. Each must start with HOW MANY, HOW MUCH, HOW LONG, or HOW TALL.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four numbered question lines.

image_placeholders.description: Four numbered question slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Each slot has '1.', '2.', '3.', '4.' on the left with a long question line. Header 'My Math Questions:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_Q: keywords (math, questions) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each question must be a math question.

parts.student_instructions: Sort 6 questions into MATH and NOT MATH. Mark M for math, N for not-math.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A 6-row sort chart.

image_placeholders.description: A 6-row sort chart in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. 6 question rows: 'How many books?', 'What colour is the library?', 'How long is recess?', 'Is the park fun?', 'How many buses arrive?', 'Does the rink smell like snow?'. Each row has M/N bubbles. Header 'Math (M) or Not Math (N)?'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_SORT: keywords (math, not) name the bubbles.

parts.answer_key: M, N, M, N, M, N.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and answer 1 of their math questions with a guess.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 worksheet introduces C4 step 1. Watch for the descriptive-vs-math question confusion. Part 3 is a TRANSFER probe: instead of sorting ready-made questions, children TURN 3 descriptive starter prompts into math questions ('It is sunny.' → 'How many sunny days this week?').
